title: Concept: Executed SQL returned in a response
description: The text of a statement echoed beside a status field in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The statement shows the table, the join and the predicate, which is the exact query an attacker would like to inject into.
applicability: Deployments that render the text of a statement echoed beside a status field into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The statement shows the table, the join and the predicate, which is the exact query an attacker would like to inject into.
